Logs in the window show cold starts with Init Duration at 128 MB, and max memory used is about 90 MB. No errors or denials appear in the window, so the impact is latent: the function is running under-provisioned relative to its intended config. The other functions' memory and timeout match the template. The environment variables also match the template. The IAM roles show no denials. The commits affecting OUTPUT_BUCKET and TABLE_NAME (32da483, 920642e) fall outside the window and were reverted, and the live values match the template, so they are not the cause.
